scripts.text:
[Li]
Have you finished hunting the 50 Dokebis?
scripts.translation:
[李]
你已經獵殺了50只土人了嗎？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text: I want to quit
scripts.translation: 我想放棄

scripts.text:
[Li]

scripts.translation:

嗯，我覺得你還沒獵殺50只呢...

scripts.text:
[Li]

scripts.translation:

記住，我需要你幫忙獵殺土人，所以去獵殺50只吧。

scripts.text:
[Li]
Are you sure that you want to stop hunting?
Any progress that you've made will be erased
scripts.translation:
[李]
你確定要停止獵殺嗎？
你目前的進度將會被清除。

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Li]
Ok then, well come back here if you change your mind.
scripts.translation:
[李]
好吧，如果你改變主意了，隨時回來找我。
